annotations.title: Read a server's recent load and memory history

description: Returns the server's load samples over the last minutes (default 30, up to 360), oldest first, one about every 30 seconds while it runs. Each point has its time, memory use, tick load in permille (divide by 20 for milliseconds per tick; 1000 means the server is lagging) and peak players. Gaps mean the server was asleep or starting. Use it to explain when and why a server lagged.

serverId.description: Server id: the id field from listServers.

minutes.description: How many minutes back to read, 1 to 360.

name: getServerMetrics
title: Read a server's recent load and memory history
